segment_captions.caption: A wide shot of a rugged landscape with snow-capped mountains in the background and a grassy foreground under a partly cloudy sky.

A wide shot of a rugged landscape with snow-capped mountains in the background and a vast, moss-covered plain in the foreground. The camera remains stationary, capturing the serene and expansive view under a partly cloudy sky.
A landscape with snow-capped mountains and a grassy foreground transitions to a painting of a man in a forested area with a waterfall and a cityscape in the background.
A woman pours water from a pitcher into a cup held by a child while a man tends to a sheep nearby. The scene depicts a pastoral setting with a tree and ruins in the background.

A woman pours from a pitcher into a cup held by a child, while a man pets a goat nearby. The scene shifts to a chaotic sky filled with angels and figures in motion, suggesting a divine or mythological event.

A chaotic scene with numerous figures engaged in dynamic movements. Angels and human-like beings are depicted in various poses, some holding weapons, others in flight. The background features a dramatic sky with clouds and light effects, enhancing the sense of turmoil and action.

A chaotic scene with figures in distress amidst a fiery landscape. Smoke billows from a burning structure, and people are scattered, some climbing structures while others appear to be running away. The sky is dark and ominous, filled with swirling clouds and distant figures that seem to be observing the chaos below.
Atlas holds up the sky, his muscles straining under the weight of the celestial sphere above him.
Atlas holds up a large celestial sphere with his right hand while standing on rocky terrain under a cloudy sky.
C stretches his arm upwards towards a large, swirling planet in the sky, maintaining a dynamic pose on rocky terrain.

A muscular figure stands in a dramatic pose against a backdrop of swirling clouds and a large celestial body. The figure's right arm is raised, hand open, as if reaching towards the sky. The scene transitions to black, indicating a possible cut or end of the segment.
A circular diagram labeled 'MARE MAGNUM' appears, depicting regions like Asia, Europe, Africa, and America. The diagram is detailed with inscriptions and symbols around it.

A circular diagram of the world is shown, with labels for Asia, Europe, Africa, and the Mare Magnum. The diagram is then colored with red, blue, and green sections, representing different regions or divisions of the world.
The map transitions from showing 'Asia' to 'Tanais' and 'Nile', indicating a shift in focus within the geographical representation.

Ocean waves crash against rugged coastal rocks, creating white foam and splashes of turquoise water. The camera pans slightly, revealing more of the rocky shoreline and the dynamic interaction between the sea and land.
A statue of Stesichorus is shown against a backdrop of green foliage.
A map of the Atlantic Ocean is shown with the text 'Atlantikoi pelágei' overlaid.

A bas-relief sculpture depicting a historical battle scene with numerous figures engaged in combat. The detailed carving shows soldiers, horses, and various weapons in motion, capturing the intensity of the battle. The background features architectural elements like columns and arches, adding depth to the scene.
A statue of a man with a beard sits pensively, resting his chin on his hand. The background features vertical columns, suggesting a classical setting.
A statue of Herodotus is shown, with his left hand resting on his chin, suggesting contemplation. The statue is draped in a garment, and the background features vertical architectural columns.
A detailed etching of Herodotus's head and shoulders is shown, focusing on his curly hair and beard.
A map of ancient geographical regions is shown, highlighting Europe, Asia, and Africa. The map includes labels for various locations and bodies of water like the Mediterranean Sea and the Red Sea.

A map of ancient regions is shown, highlighting Europe, Asia, and Africa. The text on the map is in Latin, indicating geographical names like 'Europa' and 'Asia'. A detailed illustration of Hercules battling a lion, with text describing his strength and endurance. The scene depicts Hercules in mid-action, with the lion lying defeated at his feet.
Atlas holds the sky on his shoulders while Hercules stands beside him, appearing to assist or observe.
The man on the left holds a globe with his right hand while the man on the right continues to hold it with both hands. The globe remains stationary between them.

A man in classical attire holds a globe, while another man in similar attire stands beside him, both appearing contemplative. The scene transitions to an aerial view of the Rock of Gibraltar, with text overlay identifying it.

The map shifts from focusing on Libya to showing more of Africa, highlighting regions like the Oceanus Aethiopicus and Mare Australis.

The camera pans across a detailed historical map of Africa, highlighting the region labeled 'Oceanus Aethiopicus'. The map features various ships, landforms, and annotations, including a red arrow pointing towards the southern part of the continent.

The camera pans across a detailed historical map of Africa, highlighting various geographical features and labeled regions like Oceanus Aethiopicus. The map includes illustrations of ships and animals, providing a vivid representation of the region's maritime and natural history.
